changelog: v1.1 (2026-10-12), written after the v1 run of three local models. Every model is rerun on v1.1.
summarise-03: the instruction now asks to keep the incident id, which v1 required but never asked for (all 3 omitted it).
summarise-06: the instruction now asks for the attempted and comparable counts, which v1 required but never asked for.
explain_route (all 6): the instruction now asks to name the model when one is given; route-03/route-06 required it unasked.
cluster-02: grouping all four disk-full records as one problem is also accepted, a defensible reading of 'the same underlying problem'.
Unchanged on purpose: check_context_completeness keys (each request does state what the key says it states), and every injection job.

Summarise the benchmark result in at most two sentences.
Four cloud models scored 50 of 50: Mistral Large 3, Qwen3-Coder-480B, Kimi K2.5 and Kimi K3. The default local model scored 18 of 50, while qwen2.5-coder:7b scored 37 of 50 at about four times the latency.

Summarise in one sentence what changed and why.
The readiness gate for backups used to print 'nothing schedules them' from a fixed string. It now asks Windows Task Scheduler (or crontab) and passes only when the newest archive is fresh AND a schedule exists, because a one-off archive passed for a week while nothing would ever make the next one.
